mapper.select: select config_json, version from official_event_attendance_config where event_id=#{event}
mapper.insert: insert into official_event_attendance_config(event_id,config_json,updated_by,version) values(#{event},#{json},#{actor},#{version}) on duplicate key update config_json=#{json},updated_by=#{actor},version=#{version},update_time=current_timestamp(3)
mapper.select: select * from official_event_attendance where event_id=#{event} and member_id=#{actor}
select * from official_event_attendance where event_id=#{event} and credential=#{code}
mapper.update: update official_event_attendance set credential=#{code},version=version+1 where participation_id=#{participation} and checked_at is null
update official_event_attendance set checked_at=#{at},checked_by=#{actor} where participation_id=#{participation} and checked_at is null
